messages.subject: Truncated error bars with expand=c(0,0)
parts:
Hi all,


I'm trying to draw a bar plot with error bars. The bars should touch the x axis, hence the use of expand=c(0,0) in scale_y. Here's the data:

fm_p <- structure(list(pos = structure(c(1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 
2L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L), .Label = c("N-1", "N"), class = "factor"), 
    cond = structure(c(1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 1L, 1L, 
    2L, 2L), .Label = c("A", "B"), class = "factor"), 
    variable = structure(c(1L, 1L, 1L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 
    3L, 3L, 3L), .Label = c("Var1", "Var2", 
    "Var3"), class = "factor"), m = c(169.577639751553, 
    210.428898332788, 173.388888888889, 232.126797385621, 214.045112781955, 
    280.4655116051, 216.664705882353, 318.617647058824, 15.2010460934946, 
    28.5714285714286, 15.1633986928105, 32.7450980392157), l = c(164.262400803998, 
    204.829727653837, 168.186335661882, 226.50420480359, 207.719105779585, 
    271.21257735734, 210.513028802491, 308.843777396938, 13.9461308528369, 
    26.975308469887, 13.910015220611, 31.0831750800692), u = c(174.892878699108, 
    216.02806901174, 178.591442115896, 237.749389967652, 220.371119784325, 
    289.71844585286, 222.816382962215, 328.391516720709, 16.5228952483963, 
    30.2086254715778, 16.4837675501535, 34.4400700250937), unit = c("ms", 
    "ms", "ms", "ms", "ms", "ms", "ms", "ms", "%", "%", "%", 
    "%")), row.names = c(NA, -12L), class = c("data.table", "data.frame"
), .Names = c("pos", "cond", "variable", "m", "l", "u", "unit"))

And here's the code to procude the plot:

dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)

ggplot(fm_p, aes(x=pos, y=m, group = interaction(variable, cond))) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill=cond, colour = cond), stat="identity", position = dodge) +
  geom_text(x = .75, y = Inf, aes(label=unit),
            vjust=1, size = rel(3.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=l, ymax=u), width = 0.25, position=dodge, size=3) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0)) +
  scale_colour_grey(guide="none", start=0, end=0) +
  scale_fill_grey(start=0, end=1) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(vjust=1),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_rect(colour="#000000", size=1),
        ## panel.margin = unit(rep(2,4), "lines"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(vjust=0),
        axis.title.y = element_text(vjust=0),
        plot.title = element_text(face="bold", size = rel(1.05))) +
  xlab("Word") + ylab("Mean")

The resulting plot looks like this:
The problem is that the error bars at the upper bound are truncated, leaving narrower lines. I tried using expand=c(0,0.5) but that did not have the desired effect. Does anybody have an idea how to fix this? I will use narrower lines for the final plot but the version above illustrates the problem better.

Best,
Paul
